name: Guangxi Guiguan Electric PowerCo.,Ltd.
summary: Guangxi Guiguan Electric PowerCo.,Ltd. engages in the generation and sale of electricity in China. The company is involved in the hydro, thermal, wind, energy storage, integrated, and photovoltaic power generation businesses. As of December 31, 2025, it had an installed capacity of 10,240,400 kilowatts of hydropower, and 1,330,000 kilowatts of thermal power, as well as 2,176,500 kilowatts of photovoltaic. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Nanning, China. Guangxi Guiguan Electric PowerCo.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Datang Corporation Ltd.
